profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at AAMVA
profile.summary:
•	Self-motivated, good team member with excellent analytical, research and problem solving  skills with ability to work independently as well as in team.
•	.Net Developer with 9.5 years of information technology experience in analysis, design, development, implementation, maintenance and testing of multi-tier architecture.
•	Experience with developing software applications using Microsoft technologies like VB.Net, C#.Net, ASP.Net, WCF, ADO.Net.
•	Sound knowledge of SOA principles and design patterns. Experienced creating, consuming and deploying SOAP/REST WCF web services and XML based web services.
•	Expertise in .Net 4.0 and lower versions, Object oriented concepts and business objects. Proficient in developing web user interface using ASP.Net MVC 4.0 and lower versions, ASP.Net web forms, JavaScript, CSS, Ajax, JSON, JQuery, LINQ, and HTML.
•	Sound knowledge of Design Patterns like Model View Controller (MVC), Model View View Model (MVVM).
•	Successfully either implemented/participated on N-tier, MVC, and SOA architecture for projects.
•	Experience with SQL Server 2008 and lower versions and Firebird like writing Stored Procedure, Triggers, Schemas and UDF and good experience with SQL server FILESTRAM features.
•	Experience with Team Foundation Server (TFS) and Visual Source Safe (VSS).
•	Experienced with domain knowledge of Document Management System and Division of Motor Vehicle (DMV). 
•	Experience in Win forms UI using third party tool DevExpress.
•	Sound knowledge of software development paradigms like Object Oriented Analysis and Design (OOA/OOD), Procedural Programming (Top/Down Approach) and application types like Win Forms, Web Forms, Client/Server, intranet, internet based applications.
•	Developed, configured and deployed a variety of .Net Framework Applications.

company.name: AAMVA (American Association of Motor Vehicle Administrators)

positions.title: Sr .Net Developer
positions.description:
Project: RIMS (Rhode Island DMV)
Tools/ Technology:  .Net Framework 4.0, VB.Net, Win Form, WCF, SQL Server 2008, LINQ, Entity Framework, DevExpress controls, MVVM Design Pattern, Team Foundation Server (TFS), Enterprise Architect, Resharper, JIRA, ALM and StarTeam.

RIMS is a project of RI DMV to modernized DMV system.  It’s include Registration, Title, Driving license, Accident reporting, Payment, customer/user management, administration etc. modules. Ventera is the implementing partner for HP on this project. The application is based on Client Server architecture. The services are written in Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) and the front end is developed using WinForms and DevExpress controls. The system was divided in to more than hundreds HLDs also called business processes. I mainly worked on Title, Registration, Customer and accident reporting HLDs.
Responsibility: 
•	Understand the business process from High Level Document (HLD).
•	Created Design documents for HLD using Enterprise Architect.
•	Prepare HL and LL design and get approval from HP Team before coding.
•	Responsible for interacting with the Database Management team and verifying the database model that has been generated for a particular HLD. Communicate to them about any gaps and follow up with them to get it filled.
•	Worked on multi-tier / multilayer architecture such as DAL (EF, Enterprise library),  WCF Service (Contract,  Proxies), UI (Controller, ViewModel, Binding source)
•	Creating Fees and Supporting documents Rules Engine and Implements for all HLDs.
•	Implemented the concepts of dependency injection.
•	Create UI Control Using DevExpress Tool.
•	Involved in code refactoring through Resharper. 
•	Coding using Vb.net and follow Microsoft best practices.
•	Creating SQL CRUD Procedure for Tables.
•	Using JIRA for updated Data base request and ALM and JIRA for bug tracking.
•	Utilized LINQ for data retrieval form Entity framework

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Project: Docsvault Small Business (Document Management System)
Tools/ Technology: C#.Net, VB.Net, ASP.Net, Ado.Net, SOAP/REST WCF Web Services, SOA, MVC 3.0, JQuery, Java Script, XML, HTML, CSS, Razor View Engine, JSON, LINQ, Entity      Framework, TDD, TFS, SQL Server 2008/2005, DevExpress Controls

Responsibility: 

•	Developed Web version using ASP.Net Web Forms and C#.Net With Visual Studio 2010.
•	Developed desktop version using VB.Net Win Form Controls and DevExpress Win Form Controls.
•	Implemented Web Service (WCF) using C#.Net, XML. Host Web service in IIS with different end points.
•	Work on JQuery library.  Develop web forms in C#, ASP.Net. Extensive use of Microsoft ASP.Net Ajax, Web Methods, Page Methods, JSON, XML, DevExpress web controls and JavaScript.
•	Involved in designing application tiers using the MVC Framework. Implemented ASP.Net MVC as part of presentation layer while extending features of the existing application.
•	Worked in Agile Scrum based environment. 
•	Utilized DevExpress Code Rush to code refactor and development productivity.
•	Developed and Consume WCF REST services. 
•	Created data access layer using Entity framework.
•	Created SQL Server 2008 database objects like tables, views, stored procedures and data access functions using ADO.Net.
•	Used FILESTREAM Functionality of SQL server 2008 R2
•	Involved in database design for every module and defining relations between tables.
•	Involved in complete SDLC, which includes requirement gathering, analysis, design, development, implementation, upgrade, enhancements, maintenance, support and bug fixing.
•	Implement Test Driven Development (TDD) environment using Visual Studio Unit Test Framework.
•	Implemented Document Retention Module, User/Document Security Module, Licensing and Activation Process of System.
•	Created deployment setup using MSI and deploy on IIS 7.

positions.title: Project Leader
positions.description:
Project: Docsvault Small Business (Document Management System)
Tools/ Technology: VB.Net, Win forms, Multi-Threading, WPF, Com Add Ins, XML, ADO.Net, LINQ,Windows Services, SQL Server 2005, Firebird, .Net Framework 3.5/2.0.  
Responsibility: 

•	Created application using VB.Net and DevExpress Controls
•	Involved in Socket Programming using TCP/IP and UDP through which data can be transfer from Client to Server and Server can handle multiple client request.  Its secure communication channel with Synchronous method.
•	Design functionality to map client data with XML Template using XML and LINQ
•	Developed Windows Services to transfer files between server and clients using Socket. 
•	Developed Encryption and Decryption algorithms to store and retrieve user credentials
•	Implemented Active Directory Integration using LDAP.
•	Created ADO.Net entity framework based data access. Utilized LINQ to Entity for data access
•	To transfer message sequence between two different Exe files used IPC (Inter Process Communication) by using VB.Net.
•	Used .Net Remoting to perform file operations and manage server resident file system.
•	Implemented Watch Folder feature with to process client data file by batch processer using Windows Service.
•	Implemented Office Add-ins for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, using VSTO and Visual Studio.
•	Created stored procedures, triggers, cursors and functions for the application using SQL Server.
•	Developed Complex Stored Procedures to get the data according the required functionality for Security and List.
•	Implemented multithreading activity to process data.
•	Developed Manual and Automatic backup (Schedule back up) for repository. 
•	Designed and developed mail scheduler using windows service that automatically sends emails periodically to clients.
•	Developed two tier (client/server) application using object oriented approach following appropriate design patterns.

positions.title: Software Programmer
positions.description:
Project: Orthosuite

Orthosuite is an advanced Windows-based medical management application software suite. Designed for a single-user or multiple users in a network environment, Orthosuite features a seamless integration of Medical Billing, Appointment Scheduling and Patient Information, enabling clinic managers to efficiently manage their clinics' daily operational needs. Print prescriptions right from the software but just clicking predefined medicine and criteria in multiple languages.
Responsibility: 
•	Interacted and excelled in client relations, business analysis, and utilized a team approach for requirement and functional specifications.
•	Design and Development of Billing, Promotional Schemes, Administration and Accounting Module.
•	Designed windows forms using VB.NET.
•	Wrote PL/SQL for server stored procedures, views, and tables and used ADO.NET for database transactions.
•	VSS used for version control.

Project: Rebate Xpress

Rebate system helps both the management and the customers of the company. Management can analyze whole process of Rebate right from purchase to submission and submission to verification and verification to shipping. Customers can fill up the rebate form easily and can track down their rebate status online. System have analysis module with graphical interface, so management can concentrate for particular product or on particular store. Various status of rebate is available for tracking. 

Responsibility: 
•	Formulated program specifications by creating classes to generalize codes using VB 6.0.
•	Wrote SQL statements, tables and used ADO objects for database transactions.
•	Created Classes to generalize the code using VB.
•	Wrote MS Access VBA for  Manipulating Access Forms and Macros
•	Extensively used ADO along with record set, parameter, and error objects to deal with backend processing.
•	Helped in creating setup and deployment of project.

Tools/ Technology: Visual Basic 6.0, VBA, ADO, MS Access 2003, VSS, Windows 2000/XP
